day_local: Isniinta Toddobaadka Lix iyo Labaatanaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, jacaylka Ilaah, iyo wada-jirka Ruuxa Quduuska ah ha idinla jiraan.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: I dhegayso, Rabbiyow, oo maqal eraygayga.
homily:
Waxaa jira waxyaabo yaryar oo nolosha qofka ka dhiga mid macno leh, waxyaabo aan inta badan iska indho-tirno illaa ay xilligoodu dhaafaan. Waxaan maanta maskaxdayda ku hayaa sawirka Ben oo si taxaddar leh u dhex socda garoonka diyaaradaha, isagoo indhihiisa waaweyn ee wax-raadiyaha ah ku eegaya diyaaradaha Boeing 737 ee ku sii jeeda cirka. Ma ahayn kaliya xiiso uu u qabay mashiinnada; waxay ahayd xiiso uu u qabay dunida ballaadhan ee uu Ilaah abuuray. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay inuu wax walba u arko sida qurux, sida fursad, iyo sida waddo uu ku gaari karo wax ka sarreeya xuduudaha dhulka. Waxa uu lahaa maskax aad u fiiqan, laakiin waxa uu lahaa qalbi ka sii weyn.

Akhriska koowaad ee maanta, oo ka yimid Kitaabka Job, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Naked I came forth from my mother's womb, and naked shall I go back again. The LORD gave and the LORD has taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD!' Erayadan waxaa laga yaabaa inay u muuqdaan kuwo adag, laakiin dhab ahaantii, waxay inoo sheegayaan in Ilaah mar walba uu raadinayo inuu inoo soo celiyo. Wuxuu rabaa inaynu ogaanno in nolosha ay tahay hanti yar oo la inoo dhiibay si aan ugu adeegno kuwa kale. Ben wuxuu fahmay in waxa adduunkan lagu cabbiro—lacag, guul, iyo xitaa caafimaad—aysan ahayn waxa dhabta ah ee qofka ka dhiga qof weyn.

Injiilka maanta wuxuu inoo sheegayaa Ciise oo xertiisa u sheegaya tusaalaha ilmuhu inoo yahay: 'Whoever receives this child in my name receives me, and whoever receives me receives the one who sent me.' Ciise wuxuu rabay inuu ogaado haddii ay fahamsan yihiin cidda uu yahay ka hor inta uusan u sheegin inuu 'waajib ku yahay inuu aad u xanuunsado oo la diido.' Tani waa xuddunta iimaankeena. Masiixu wuxuu dhex galay xanuunka aadanaha si uu u beddelo. Markaad maanta dareemaysaan culayska, Alan iyo Thao, markaad xusuusanaysaan Ben oo ku leh 'Good morning, Dad,' ama markaad Ryan xusuusanaysaan wada-socodkiinnii, ogow in Ciise uu dhex fadhiisto xanuunkaas. Wuxuu yaqaan macnaha la diido, macnaha la xanuunsado, iyo macnaha la lumiyo qof aad jeceshahay.

Waxaan rabaa inaan si gaar ah ula hadlo waalidiinta. Waxaan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ay dareemayeen sida buur culus oo saaran xabadka. Waxaan ogahay in habeenkii, marka aad eegto sawirrada Ben, aad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta dhex fadhiisto xanuunkaas idinkala socda oo aan idiin sheego si cad: Waxba ma aad seegin. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Xanuunka iyo dhimashada aan la fileynin ee soo martay Ben ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise ugu jawaabay markii la weydiiyay sababta uu ninku u dhashay indhoolaha: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Jacaylka aad Ben siisateen—sheekooyinkii, safarradii, iyo xanaanadii aad u haysay—wuxuu ahaa nuurka dhabta ah ee noloshiisa. Ha isku dayin inaad xalliso xanuunkaaga adigoo isticmaalaya xisaabtaada. Ha isku dayin inaad fahanto sababta uu Ben u baxay. Kaliya u dhiib qalbigaaga Ciise.

Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay inuu bixiyo. Xusuuso markuu ahaa 15 sano jir, ee uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabay inuu siiyo dhammaan lacagta sanduuqiisa yar si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanayd. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas safka hore kaga jiray ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa xigmadda dhabta ah ee Masiixu inoo sheegayo. Taasi waa jacayl aan xisaab lahayn, jacayl aan sugin mahadcelin, jacayl si fudud u bixiya naftiisa. Ben wuxuu baray qoyskiisa in jacaylku aanu ahayn waxa aad haysato, laakiin waa waxa aad diyaar u tahay inaad bixiso.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in dunidaadu ay isbeddeshay. Waxaan ogahay in kursiga agtaada ah uu mararka qaarkood u muuqdo mid madhan. Laakiin xusuuso, Ben wuxuu kula joogaa jacaylka aad u hayso. Sida uu kuugu sheegay riyadaada, halkaas oo aad ku wada raacdeen 'roller coaster', xidhiidhka idinka dhexeeya wuu sii socdaa. Ha ka cabsan inaad noolaato, ha ka cabsan inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdo. Wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa.

Markaad ka baxaysaan meeshan maanta, qaado hal shay oo yar: Ha ku tiirsanaan xigmaddaada marka culaysku yimaado. U dhiib qalbigaaga Ciise. Ha joojiso inaad is-eedeyso. Ogow in Ben uu ku jiro nabadda iyo gacmaha Aabbaha, oo uu halkaas idinku sugayo. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay meel nabdoon, wuxuuna idin leeyahay: 'Haku murugoonina si xad dhaaf ah; waan idin daawanayaa.' Ha iloobin in jacaylka Ben uu weli ku nool yahay adduunkan. Sida ceelka biyaha ee Cà Mau, ee uu magaciisa ku qoran yahay, jacaylkiisu wuxuu u socdaa dadka harraadsan, isagoo u keenaya nolol iyo rajo. Sidaas oo kale, qalbiyadiinna ha u furnaadaan rajo cusub. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan rumeysanahay inaad joogto Sakramental Quduuska ah. Waan ku jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan naftayda kuu dhiibo. Maadaama aanan hadda kuu qaadan karin Sakrament ahaan, fadlan naftayda ku soo gal si ruuxi ah. Waan ku soo dhaweynayaa sidii inaad horey u timid. Ha ii oggolaan inaan weligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Benjamin iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay ee dhintay, inuu Rabbigu u furo albaabbada naxariistiisa oo uu siiyo nasasho weligeed ah, waxaan Rabbiga ka baryaynaa.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan iyo kuwa culayska saaran, inuu Ilaah u soo dejiyo naxariistiisa, u qalbi-qaboojiyo, oo u iftiimiyo rajo cusub, waxaan Rabbiga ka baryaynaa.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah markii malaa'igaha Ilaah yimaadeen inay Rabbiga hortiisa istaagaan, Shaydaankuna wuxuu la yimid iyaga. Rabbiguna wuxuu Shaydaanka ku yidhi, 'Xaggee baad ka timid?' Shaydaankiina wuxuu Rabbiga ugu jawaabay, 'Anigoo dhulka dhex maraya oo rooraya.' Rabbiguna wuxuu Shaydaanka ku yidhi, 'Ma u kuurgashay addoonkayga Job, oo aan dhulka mid la mid ah jirin, nin qumman oo toosan, Ilaah ka cabsada oo xumaanta ka fogaada?' Laakiin Shaydaankii wuxuu Rabbiga ugu jawaabay, 'Ma wax aan micne lahayn baa Job Ilaah uga cabsadaa? Miyaadan isaga iyo reerkiisa iyo wixii uu haysto oo dhan ku wareejin difaac? Waxaad barakaysay shuqulkii gacmihiisa, xoolihiisuna way ku faafeen dalka. Laakiin hadda gacantaada soo taag oo taabso wax kasta oo uu haysto, hubaal wuu kugu caayi doonaa wejigaaga.' Rabbiguna wuxuu Shaydaanka ku yidhi, 'Bal eeg, wixii uu haysto oo dhami gacantaada ayay ku jiraan; kaliya ha taaban qofkiisa.' Markaasuu Shaydaankii Rabbiga hortiisa ka tegey. Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, iyadoo wiilashiisii iyo gabdhihiisii ay wax cunayaan oo khamri cabbayaan guriga walaalkooda ugu weyn, ayaa wargeeye u yimid Job oo ku yidhi, 'Lo'dii baa qodayay oo dameerihii baa daaqayay iyagoo agtooda ah, markaasay reer Saba soo weerareen oo qaateen. Waxay dileen xoolo-raacii, aniguna waxaan ahay kii kaliya ee soo baxsaday si aan kuugu warramo.' Isagoo weli hadlaya ayaa mid kale yimid oo yidhi, 'Hillaac baa samada ka soo dhacay oo laayay idihii iyo xoolo-raacii, aniguna waxaan ahay kii kaliya ee soo baxsaday si aan kuugu warramo.' Isagoo weli hadlaya ayaa mid kale yimid oo yidhi, 'Reer Kaldayiin baa sameeyay saddex saf, way qabsadeen geelii, wayna kaxaysteen, waxayna dileen xoolo-raacii, aniguna waxaan ahay kii kaliya ee soo baxsaday si aan kuugu warramo.' Isagoo weli hadlaya ayaa mid kale yimid oo yidhi, 'Wiilashaadii iyo gabdhihii baa cunayay oo khamri cabbayay guriga walaalkooda ugu weyn, markaasay dabayl xoog leh ka timid lamadegaanka oo ku dhufatay afarta gees ee guriga. Wuu ku dumay dhalinyaradii wayna dhinteen; aniguna waxaan ahay kii kaliya ee soo baxsaday si aan kuugu warramo.' Markaasuu Job bilaabay inuu dartiisa jeexjeexo oo timihiisa xiirto. Wuxuu dhulka isku tuuray, wuxuuna yidhi, 'Anigoo qaawan ayaan ka imid uurka hooyaday, qaawanna ayaan ku noqon doonaa. Rabbiga bixiyey oo Rabbiga qaaday; mahad naq ha u ahaato magaca Rabbiga!' Waxaas oo dhan Job kuma dembaabin, mana uusan oran wax aan xushmad lahayn oo Ilaah ku saabsan.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. (6) I dhegayso, Rabbiyow, oo maqal eraygayga. Maqal, Rabbiyow, dacwad xaq ah; u fiirso qayladayda; dhegayso baryadayda oo ka imanaysa bushimaha aan khiyaanada lahayn. R. I dhegayso, Rabbiyow, oo maqal eraygayga. Adiga ha iga timaaddo xukunkaygu; indhahaagu ha arkeen waxa saxda ah. In kastoo aad qalbigayga tijaabisay, adigoo habeenkii baaraya, in kastoo aad dab igu tijaabisay, kama heli doontid wax xumaan ah. R. I dhegayso, Rabbiyow, oo maqal eraygayga. Waan kuu yeerayaa, waayo waad ii jawaabi doontaa, Ilaahow; dhegayso, Rabbiyow, oo maqal eraygayga. Muuji naxariistaada yaabka leh, adigoo ah badbaadiyaha kuwa ka cararaya cadowgooda oo magan u ah gacantaada midig. R. I dhegayso, Rabbiyow, oo maqal eraygayga.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Dood baa dhex martay xertii oo ku saabsan kooda ugu weyn. Ciise wuxuu gartay ujeeddada qalbiyadooda, wuxuuna qabsaday ilmo yar oo dhinac dhigay, wuxuuna ku yidhi, 'Qof kasta oo ilmanahan ku qaabila magacayga wuu i qaabilaa, qof kasta oo i qaabila wuxuu qaabilaa kii i soo diray. Waayo, kan ugu yar dhammaantiin waa kan ugu weyn.' Markaasuu Yooxanaa ku jawaabay, 'Macallinow, waxaan aragnay qof magacaaga jinniyo ka saaraya, waana ka horjoogsannay maxaa yeelay naguma raacsana.' Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, 'Ha ka horjoogsanina, waayo qof kasta oo aan idin ka soo horjeedin waa idinla jiraa.'

day: Monday of the Twenty-sixth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
